verdict.rationale: Meta's docs state that Llama 3.1 adds function calling and agent-optimized inference, so the model itself has a first-party tool-calling capability. The evidence is a single thin claim with no detail on how tools are defined or orchestrated, and the developer docs pages sat behind an SSO wall when fetched. Missing for 10: typed tool-definition schema docs, parallel tool-call support, multi-step agent-loop documentation, evidence of faithful call accuracy, publicly readable docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — typed tool definitions, parallel and multi-step calls — documented well enough to run an agent loop on this model

citations.quote: Llama 3.1 provides significant new features, including function calling and agent-optimized inference
